test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

He is enjoying the programme very much. He want to stay till the end.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'He want to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in** 'He want to'.**
 
• The sentence has an error of **'Subject Verb Agreement'.**
 
• Here,** 'He'** is **'Third person singular number'**, So, the verb after the pronoun **'He'** will always be **'Plural in Present Tense'.**
 
• So, replacing **'Want'** with **'Wants'** will make the sentence grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'stay till the end'** is not correct here.
 
• **'the program very much'** is not correct here.
 
• **'He is enjoying' **is not correct here.
